notes: FATHER DROPPED FROM RECORD + INVENTED EPITHETS (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): this individual (b. c.1521, of Gidea Hall) is listed with only one parent, 'Lady Anne of Brittany Fitzwilliam (COOKE)' (I182541960255) — the real Anne Fitzwilliam, wife of Sir Anthony Cooke (1501/5-1576), Tudor humanist and tutor to Edward VI. Anthony Cooke himself, one of the best-documented Tudor gentlemen in England, does not appear as a parent here and should be added. The epithets 'Woodstocke' (for this son) and 'of Brittany' (for his mother, an Essex/London family with no Breton connection) appear in no source found and read as invented flourish. — Wikipedia: Anthony Cooke; History of Parliament Online: Cooke, Sir Anthony.
